content: Create a production-ready character reference sheet for “Rico,” a tiny male tan Chihuahua who behaves like an overconfident adult. Rico is a photorealistic Chihuahua with a warm honey-tan coat, a cream-coloured muzzle, chest and inner ears, enormous upright ears, large dark-brown eyes, a small black nose and a subtly mischievous smile. His proportions remain recognisably canine, but he comfortably stands upright on two legs and uses his front paws to hold simple objects. He is extremely small, slim and agile, approximately 50 cm tall when standing upright. His permanent signature outfit is a pair of cobalt-blue tropical shorts decorated with orange and yellow hibiscus flowers. The shorts fit securely around his waist. He wears a narrow red fabric wristband on his right front paw. No shirt, shoes, jewellery or collar. Personality visible through posture: self-confident, resourceful, dramatic, slightly dishonest, convinced that he is the smartest person in the room. His resting expression should look serious and responsible, making his ridiculous behaviour funnier. Create one clean six-panel character sheet showing: 1. Full-body front view, neutral pose 2. Full-body left profile 3. Full-body rear view 4. Three-quarter standing pose 5. Close-up neutral facial reference 6. Expression row: smug confidence, sudden fear, guilty smile, exhausted disbelief and direct deadpan camera stare. Neutral light-grey studio background, soft even studio lighting, accurate fur detail, consistent markings and proportions in every panel. Photorealistic live-action appearance, not illustration, not 3D animation. No text, labels, logos, props or additional characters.
